syllabus_title: WAEC SSCE Islamic Religious Studies Detailed Syllabus

topics.title: The Jahiliyyah: Arabia before Islam
subtopics: Social Life - Marriage, divorce and inheritance
Religious life - Idol worship and names of major gods/idols
The Reforms introduced by Islam on the Jahiliyyah practices

topics.title: The life of Prophet Muhammad (S.A.W.)
subtopics: Call to prophethood and his mission
Formation of the Ummah and the Madinan Constitution
The Battles: Badr, Uhud and Khandaq (causes, courses and effects)
The Treaty of Hudaybiyyah: terms and outcomes
The Farewell Pilgrimage: description, sermon and its lessons

topics.title: The Khulafā’ur-Rāshidīn (The Rightly-guided Caliphs)
subtopics: Abu Bakr Ibn Abī Quhhāfah, ‘Umar Ibn al-Khattāb, ‘Uthmān Ibn ‘Affān and ‘Ali Ibn Abī Tālib

topics.title: Islam in West Africa
subtopics: The advent and roles of traders, teachers, murābitun, sufi orders, mujaddidun (reformers) and Hajj in the spread of Islam
The Impact of Islam on the Socio-Political, Economic and Linguistic Lives of the Peoples of ancient West African empires (Ghana, Mali, Songhai and Kanem-Borno)

topics.title: Revelation of the Qur’an
subtopics: Visits of the Prophet (S.A.W.) to Cave Hira
First revelation and his reaction to it

topics.title: Preservation of the Qur’an
subtopics: Complete arrangement including distinction between Makki and Madani Suwar
Roles played by the Companions of the Prophet (S.A.W.) in the Preservation of the Qur’an

topics.title: Importance of the Qur’an
topics.description: The Qur’an as a source of guidance in social, political, spiritual and moral matters

topics.title: Selected Surahs
topics.description: Reading (in either Arabic Text or Transliteration), Memorization, Meaning of the following suwar and the lessons learnt from them (Identification, Explanation, Interpretation and Application)

topics.title: Introduction to Hadith
subtopics: Differences and similarities between Hadith and Sunnah
The Importance of Hadith and Sunnah
Parts of the Hadith: ‘Isnad, Matn and Rawi
Classification of Hadith: Sahih, Hasan and Da‘if
The Six Sound Collections of Hadith (Sihaus-Sittah) and their Compilers

topics.title: Selected Ahadith
topics.description: Reading (in either the Arabic Text or Transliteration), Memorization, Meaning of the following Ahadith and lessons learnt from them (Identification, Explanation, Interpretation and Application): an-Nawawi’s Collection: 1, 5, 7, 9, 13, 15, 16, 18, 34 and 41

parts.title: TAWHID AND FIQH (ISLAMIC THEOLOGY AND JURISPRUDENCE)

topics.title: Iman (Faith)
subtopics: Belief in Allah with emphasis on Kalimatush-Shahadah (relevant verses)
Belief in His Prophets with special emphasis on the Ulul-‘Azm
Belief in the Day of Resurrection, Judgement and Eternal Life
Belief in Destiny – Qada’ and Qadar

topics.title: Salat (Prayer)
subtopics: Kinds of Salat and how they are observed (Obligatory, Non-Obligatory, Special prayers, Salatus-Safar)

topics.title: Zakat (Charity)
subtopics: Articles on which Zakat is paid
Zakat on Livestock, Money, Agricultural Products
Benefits of Zakat – Spiritual, Socio-economic and Moral

topics.title: Sawm (Fasting)
subtopics: How fasting is observed in Islam

topics.title: Hajj (Pilgrimage)
subtopics: Definition and Origin of Hajj and ‘Umrah
Pre-requisite to the performance of Hajj
Acts that affect the validity of Hajj
Types of Hajj (Ifrad, Tamattu‘ and Qiran)
Significance of Hajj (spiritual, socio-economic and moral objectives)

topics.title: Shari‘ah
subtopics: Sources (the Qur’an, the Sunnah, the Ijma‘ and the Qiyas)

topics.title: Nikah (Marriage)
subtopics: Rights and duties of husband and wife
Law prohibiting the Ill-treatment of Wife

topics.title: Talaq (Divorce)
subtopics: Kinds – Talaq, Khul‘, Faskh, Mubara‘ah, Zihar and Li‘an
